checks_before_registration: Two spot-reader tests and two feature tests pass, including headerless first-row preservation, timestamp units, strict delay boundaries, past-prefix invariance, exact small-window arithmetic, and ignored future-target fields. Ruff passes.
controls: Apply exactly the same feature function to the existing perpetual trades at 100ms. This separates newly engineered trade-state information from the incremental contribution of the spot stream. The 500ms variant measures sensitivity to a larger assumed information delay, not an observed receive-time guarantee.
integrity: Separate observation-only sidecars preserve every original decision timestamp and leave original feature files unchanged. Verify original feature hashes and both official raw archive hashes; require finite features and exact save/reload equality.
known_quote_contract: Use only existing decision_time/bid/ask/bid_qty/ask_qty columns; never receive labels, future prices or resolutions. A source trade is available only when transaction_time+the registered delay is strictly earlier than the decision. Features at a decision never use a later source record. Spot transaction prices are not spot quotes or spot executable spreads.
observations: Last available trade, signed run length, trade-price/perpetual-mid log basis, spot price changes across 1/5/15/60 seconds, clock-aware causal basis means and deviations at 60/300/3600-second half-lives. Trade windows of 1/5/15/60 seconds and 8/32/128 events measure quantity, side, VWAP basis, persistence, concentration and elapsed time. Perpetual quantities normalize signed trade volume in the same base-asset units.
